post2023_ticker_attrition.rule: a frozen asset survives the one-time download only if it resolves and has non-missing returns on at least 80% of post-2023 benchmark sessions; survivors keep frozen manifest order; a market needs at least 15 survivors; dropped assets are recorded and never replaced

frozen_threshold.definition: median trailing-20-session benchmark-return standard deviation at the final context date of each 2023 validation origin
